record.body: R87 propagated the existing runner-independent ForcedTop25 qualification capsule into three already-GGEN-owned forced consumers. SREGym PR #6, fdegym PR #7 and mfact PR #10 each contain four independently committed semantic transitions and each exact head passed its owning R87 court; fdegym and mfact also passed repository CI surfaces observed on those heads. No upstream factory commits were needed and no merge was performed. The widest unresolved frontier remains U>=17 with eight forced targets requiring deep compatibility scan and additional root-positive consumers available for later R86 propagation.
